I will go through each day of the week (Monday, Nov 16 to Friday, Nov 20) from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM and list all the 30-minute slots where both Priya and Marcus are free.

Monday: 9:00-9:30, 9:30-10:00
Tuesday: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wednesday: 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00
Thursday: 10:00-10:30
Friday: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00

Now that I have a list of potential meeting times, I need to communicate this to Brad. I will use the `append_workspace` function to post this list and ask him to check the availability of Elena Soto and David Okafor for these times. This is the crucial step for our collaboration. I will then end my session, as I have used three actions and need to wait for Brad's response.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
